title: Edmonton River Valley 90-Minute Winter Segway Trek
includes: One Segway Certified Guide Per Group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
A maximum of 10 people per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this 90-minute Segway tour of Edmonton, Alberta, you will receive in-depth training from a certified Segway trainer. After the training, get ready for the experience of a lifetime as you ride through Edmonton’s world famous river valley. 

Please Note: A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
